title: Curvature Under Attack in hZACH-ViT: Gauge Symmetry, Boundary Saturation, and Adversarial Failure
abstract: arXiv:2610.00680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Curvature is often treated as an intrinsic property of a representation, although its empirical effect also depends on coordinate scale, learned logit temperature, and numerical safeguards. We study this interaction in hZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer with Euclidean, Poincare, and spherical prototype heads. The backbone architecture, seed-specific initialization, 50-per-class training subset, and optimization protocol are matched across three MedMNIST datasets and five seeds. At the fixed comparison curvature $c=1$, Poincare has the lowest class-macro PGD attack-success rate in all 12 dataset-budget cells and under a stronger CE+DLR multi-restart attack on all three datasets, but it also has the lowest clean MacroF1. An end-to-end curvature intervention changes the interpretation. Reducing Poincare curvature to $c=0.1$ improves clean MacroF1 in every one of the 15 paired seed-dataset comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping,

translated_title: hZACH-ViT中遭受攻击的曲率：规范对称性、边界饱和与对抗失效
translated_abstract: 曲率通常被视为一种表示的内在属性，但其实际效果还取决于坐标尺度、可学习的logit温度以及数值保护措施。我们在hZACH-ViT中研究这种相互作用，hZACH-ViT是一个带有欧几里得、庞加莱和球面原型头的紧凑型视觉Transformer。骨干网络架构、特定种子初始化、每类50个样本的训练子集以及优化协议在三个MedMNIST数据集和五个随机种子上保持一致。在固定比较曲率c=1时，庞加莱模型在全部12个数据集-攻击预算组合中，以及在三个数据集上更强的CE+DLR多重启攻击下，均具有最低的类宏平均PGD攻击成功率，但其干净样本的宏F1也最低。端到端的曲率干预改变了这一解释：将庞加莱曲率降低至c=0.1，在全部15组配对的种子-数据集比较中都提升了干净样本宏F1，并消除了硬边界截断，
tldr: 该论文通过对hZACH-ViT的端到端曲率干预证明，曲率并非表示的内在属性：庞加莱头在固定曲率c=1时对抗鲁棒性最强但干净精度最低，而将曲率降至c=0.1可在全部配对比较中提升干净宏F1并消除硬边界饱和，从而改变了对其鲁棒性优势的解释。
en_tdlr: Through an end-to-end curvature intervention in hZACH-ViT, this paper shows that curvature is not an intrinsic property of representations: Poincaré heads at fixed c=1 are most adversarially robust but least accurate, while lowering curvature to c=0.1 improves clean MacroF1 in all paired comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping, reframing the interpretation of its robustness advantage.
